revision_summary: Overall trajectory read, bill-anchor-miss framing, and outcome reclassification (callback, not booked appointment) are all well-supported and should be kept. Required fixes on rerun: (1) Fix the minor quote transcription mismatch at 02:39 — transcript says 'there are there some trees already cut down' (no 'have' inserted) — correct the quoted text in script_coverage's implicit reference. (2) Correct the schema citation in cherry_pick_moments[3] (04:08 tree-clearing enthusiasm) — this is NOT a cross_sell_signals.roof_replacement_planned trigger (that requires an actual new-roof mention); relabel as a generic enthusiasm/customer-initiative signal with no cross-sell schema citation. (3) Correct the schema citation in cherry_pick_moments[4] (03:15 photo request) — stop citing call_shape.required_beats.bill_collection for a roof-photo workaround; this conflates the roof-photo ask with the separately-and-correctly-flagged missed bill_collection beat. Reframe as an ad hoc design-blocker workaround outside formal required beats. (4) Soften the handoff_brief's speculative 'possible cognitive or communication difficulty' language to a neutral communication-style note (tangential/rambling, needs patience) — avoid clinical inference not grounded in transcript or schema. (5) Reconsider the vulnerability_disclosure tag applied to 'I'm tired' (05:53) — schema's vulnerability categories (health/financial/family/scam) don't cleanly cover simple end-of-call fatigue; either drop the schema citation or explicitly note it's a borderline/analogical use, not a strict match. (6) Optionally add a missed-moment note on the customer's reference to a seven-year-old prior design/picture (02:52) as a competitive-context signal per verify.prior_designs, and note the generic/legitimacy-light quality of the intro at 00:06 (no state mention, minor talk-over at 00:21) per intros.standard success_signals — both are in-scope per analysis_directives and were skipped despite being directly relevant.
